messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync to finalize GA slice for the unified API (chat, embed, rerank). Need firm acceptance bullets by EOD so I can lock the PRD.
Liam Chen: Quick clarifying Q: do we treat rerank as an independent product flag or part of the chat surface? impacts telemetry and billing.
Anika Gomez: product suggestion: rerank is a cross-cutting option on search/completions calls. Expose `rerank.enabled` and `rerank.mode` (values: "nondet","stable").
Ravi Singh: infra constraints: stable mode requires sticky sessions + increased KV retention. That means reserved capacity for pilots; otherwise latency tail will suffer.
Jordan Brooks: SDK changes: add top-level `rerank` object and `client_hints.max_cost_units`. Example:
{ "model": "redwood-chat-2", "rerank": {"enabled": true, "mode": "nondet"}, "client_hints": {"max_cost_units": 5} }
Zara Lee: From customer success: pilot customers want deterministic outputs and per-request cost visibility. They also requested an explicit header when fallback happens.
Maya Patel: Draft acceptance criteria for GA slice:
- Contract: additive params only; stable_rerank gated for pilots.
- Performance: hosted 95th latency targets for GA traffic profile: chat <= 210ms, embeddings <= 140ms, rerank <= 320ms.
- Quality gates: rerank nondet top-1 swap <= 3% vs baseline on seed set; stable mode <= 0.8% for pilot cohort. Embedding drift (mean cosine delta) <= 0.018 after quant.
- Observability: include per-request cost header `x-rw-cost-units` and `x-rw-fallback-reason` when used.
- Failure modes: documented graceful fallback -> return original unranked list + `x-rw-fallback-reason: rerank_unavailable`.
Liam Chen: Add hard QA block: any quantization that increases embedding drift beyond 0.02 on pinned test corpus is blocked for GA. QA to run nightly sweep.
Anika Gomez: Edge cases to call out in spec: inputs with >30k tokens -> 413 + guidance; embeddings with NaN/Inf -> 400 + detailed error; empty chat array -> 422 + example payload.
Ravi Singh: Ops notes: KV eviction must prefer session-affinity keys for stable rerank; also autoscaler to pre-warm dedicated pilot pool on schedule. I'll add tickets.
Jordan Brooks: SDK UX: when `rerank.mode=stable` and customer is on free-tier, warn and require explicit opt-in. We'll ship a minor version bump.
Zara Lee: I'll line up pilot invites for three customers once product locks the gating. They want route-level billing and deterministic outputs.
Maya Patel: Owners: product=Maya, eng=Ravi, SDK=Jordan, QA=Liam, research=Anika, pilots=Zara. Next steps:
- Anika: run overnight quant sweep and post results.
- Ravi: open infra tickets for pilot pool + KV tuning.
- Jordan: draft SDK PR and changelog.
- Liam: create eval harness repo and add baseline tests.
Maya Patel: Any blockers?
Ravi Singh: Main risk is onboarding new rerank variants that change tokenization. We should freeze candidate model list by Tue to avoid slips.
Anika Gomez: I'll prioritize the embedding stability runs tonight.
Maya Patel: Great. I'll update the PRD with these acceptance bullets and owners and circulate. Thanks everyone.
